messages:
Mira: Customer BrightCloud reports they completed a promo checkout on the webflow flow, got the "success" email, but their account balance still shows 0. org=brightcloud-123, user=alice@brightcloud.com
Sam: Can you paste the confirmation email or transaction id?
Mira: Pasted: email id e_987, transaction redeem_01GZ9X. Screenshot uploaded to the thread. Link: https://redwood.app/claims/redeem_01GZ9X
billing-ops: Found webhook received: POST /webhooks/promo at 2024-12-18T14:02:03Z id=wh_8f3a. Payload indicates amount=1000, status=accepted.
billing-ops: Ledger ingestion attempted but flagged as skipped. Relevant log snippet below:
```
2024-12-18T14:02:10Z INFO  ingest_worker apply_promo redeem_01GZ9X org=brightcloud-123 amount=1000
2024-12-18T14:02:10Z WARN  ingest_worker skip applying promo: account_state=inactive
```
Jordan: That skip path came from the account-state guard added in release v2.8.0 — if an account is "inactive" we intentionally avoid auto-applying credits.
Mira: Customer says they were mid-plan-change today; they should be active. Could this be a transient state set during migration?
Mike: Yep — there's a small window in the plan-change workflow where we flip to "inactive" while moving billing metadata. If the ingest worker hits that window it skips. I can run a targeted reapply for redeem_01GZ9X; it will be idempotent.
billing-ops: Please run it and confirm ledger posting. We need idempotency so no double-credit.
Mike: Starting reapply job reapply_1798501234 at 2024-12-18T14:06:20Z.
support-bot: Background job apply_promo_replay completed for redeem_01GZ9X, result=applied amount=1000
billing-ops: Confirmed — ledger shows credit posted, new balance: 1000 tokens for org brightcloud-123. Marked original webhook as reconciled.
Mira: I'll notify the customer that credits are visible now. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
Sam: I will file a small follow-up to reduce the inactive window during plan-change so this doesn't recur.
Mira: Customer confirmed via DM that they see the 1000 credits. Closing thread."
